note: Product-side candidates only. Measurement repairs are listed separately and require their own owner authorization. No case IDs or corpus strings appear in repair logic descriptions (anti-overfit rule).

candidates.title: Structured route-proposition construction with evidence binding
candidates.description: Planner/route-construction stage must emit each candidate route as a structured proposition: {target service family, access path, conditions[], evidence_ids[]}, bound to its supporting evidence entries via a shared key. Fragments (headings, URLs, status phrases) must never be emitted as route labels; when no actionable proposition can be constructed from in-track evidence, the case must explicitly emit no_route_asserted with a reason code instead of silent absence.
candidates.regression_risk: Medium: changes route output shape; R3 scorer interplay will shift verdicts (structured routes present removes unconditional PREMATURE_ABSENCE fire, which is the correct product direction, not tuning)
minimum_tests: route-proposition schema validation (every route has target+access_path, evidence_ids resolve to existing evidence entries)
fragment-label negative tests (headings/URLs must be rejected as labels)

candidates.title: Renderer source-block deduplication (RC-06-lite)

candidates.expected_criteria_affected: none directly; reduces forbidden-claim text surface (contamination-shaped)
candidates.description: Collapse repeated national-information blocks to one canonical block per source topic; do not alter route/critical/uncertainty logic.
minimum_tests: block-count regression (2+ national blocks per case)
